mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO attraction_likes (user_id, attraction_no) VALUES (#{userId}, #{attractionNo})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attraction_likes WHERE attraction_no = #{attractionNo}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM attractions WHERE no = #{attractionNo})

SELECT a.no, a.title, a.first_image1 AS image_url, s.sido_name AS sido, g.gugun_name AS gugun, ct.content_type_name AS content_type, CONCAT_WS(' ', a.addr1, a.addr2) AS address, COALESCE(rs.avg_rating, 0) AS avg_rating, COALESCE(rs.review_count, 0) AS review_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attraction_likes al2 WHERE al2.attraction_no = a.no) AS like_count, al.created_at AS liked_at FROM attraction_likes al JOIN attractions a ON a.no = al.attraction_no LEFT JOIN sidos s ON a.area_code = s.sido_code LEFT JOIN guguns g ON a.area_code = g.sido_code AND a.si_gun_gu_code = g.gugun_code LEFT JOIN contenttypes ct ON a.content_type_id = ct.content_type_id LEFT JOIN review_stats rs ON rs.target_type = 'ATTRACTION' AND rs.target_id = a.no WHERE al.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY al.created_at DESC, al.id DESC
